### Bible Pathways 05/17/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-17-or-2002-1133436.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 17:16
Points:
- God answered David's desire to build a temple by promising an eternal royal house fulfilled in Jesus Christ.
- David responded with genuine humility and gratitude rather than self-entitlement, wondering why God brought him so far.
- Recognizing the Lord's incomparable greatness silences human pride and awakens deep reverence.
- Believers honor God by praising Him even when His answer disappoints their personal plans.
- Christians should stand in awe of God's unmerited grace in granting eternal life.
